path_inventory_basis: Tracked shell/Python executable occurrences of n8n import:workflow, publish:workflow, unpublish:workflow, workflow_entity mutations and registry/health stage writers. Runtime operator scripts outside Git not audited here.

paths.effective_gate: framework gate optional default None; basic importer validation mandatory only where caller invokes checker
paths.gap: Caller can omit --framework-gate activation; no mutation itself
paths.minimal_fix: Make existing framework evaluation mandatory by default; carry exact graph/config/release-bound host evidence/accepted exceptions; missing/unavailable evidence blocks.

paths.effective_gate: basic import checker, generated graph verify, relay contract
paths.gap: omits framework flag; file whole SRC set; current static facts cannot substitute runtime acceptance
paths.minimal_fix: shared mandatory checker with exact reviewed file set and manifests

paths.effective_gate: basic checker then state/collision reread and import
paths.gap: framework optional omitted; CLI error swallowed by ||true with state readback; activation grant merely nonempty env in packet unless host mechanism validates externally
paths.minimal_fix: common admission wrapper validates authentic scoped grant, exact staged bytes and existing shared gate immediately before CLI import; preserve inactive/readback/rollback

paths.effective_gate: preflight basic checker; generated graph verify; inactive row reread
paths.gap: optional framework gate omitted; only nonempty TRADEAI_FABRIC_GRANT locally
paths.minimal_fix: same shared admission wrapper; exact IDs,digests,grant semantics

paths.effective_gate: preflight inactive row, nonempty grant env, time-window hold
paths.gap: no framework gate on exact exported current row immediately before publish; source files and installed row can diverge
paths.minimal_fix: export/read actual version -> verify exact reviewed graph/policy digest -> shared gate -> real grant checker -> publish -> export/readback receipt; avoid source-only preflight

paths.effective_gate: preflight and grant presence; publish probe
paths.minimal_fix: same wrapper; canary requires narrowly reviewed runtime obligations or time-bounded explicit exceptions, actual automatic trigger and host delivery evidence

paths.effective_gate: lane_dispatch gates, allowlist validation, reviewed health contract and specific hold checks
paths.gap: does not call workflow framework activation gate for affected workflow when stage promoted
paths.minimal_fix: reuse shared gate before first affected stage mutation, bind complete cohort/workflow/file before-image set, preserve active holds

paths.effective_gate: qualifying evidence, downstream, drain, P1 sessions, before-images, journal and guard mechanism
paths.gap: no unified framework gate; comprehensive48h+natural-cycle+stronger-policy eligibility contract absent at baseline
paths.minimal_fix: shared gate in controller before journal mutation intent; same controller for manual and scheduled; expired grant=audited hold, no automatic policy rewriting

paths.effective_gate: joins actual activation/import timestamps to grant-log windows and workflow IDs
paths.gap: Detects after mutation; cannot enforce admission. Cannot be called activation gate evidence by itself.
paths.minimal_fix: retain independent detection; feed immutable evidence after shared admission wrapper, never use attribution as preapproval

paths.effective_gate: native n8n authenticated admin authorization plus intended network isolation; no repository runtime admission hook observed
paths.gap: Any raw publish or UI activation could bypass scripts; same-uid host compromise can bypass source wrappers
paths.minimal_fix: canonical mutation adapter only under scoped authentic grants plus operational restriction/removal of raw mutation authority or supported runtime admission extension. Do not claim source lint confines arbitrary native admin.

shared_gate_residual: gate_workflow only requires truthy ref+observed_at, not attestation/verdict/expiry/digest binding; exceptions trust operator label and integer PR. Strengthen this existing owner instead of a second verdict engine.
canonical_authority: AGENTS14.0 active; framework11.0 §23.24 activation bar and cutover12.0 §23.25 active. No n8n deployment/approval/grant authority created by this audit.
